claims: The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal (Huntrix Meal) is a limited-time adult meal.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal (Huntrix Meal) was launched on March 31, 2026.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal (Huntrix Meal) is inspired by the KPop Demon Hunters film.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal includes 10-piece Chicken McNuggets.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal includes Ramyeon McShaker Fries with soy-garlic seasoning.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal includes a medium drink.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal includes two new sauces.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal includes Hunter Sauce (sweet chili).
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal includes purple-colored Demon Sauce (tangy mustard).
Ramyeon McShaker Fries are fries with a spicy, umami soy-garlic seasoning added to a shaker bag.
The Huntrix Meal includes a special pack of KPop Demon Hunters photocards.
The Huntrix Meal is available at participating McDonald's locations starting March 31, 2026, for a limited time.
The Huntrix Meal includes Medium Fries.
The Huntrix Meal includes a Medium Soft Drink.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal is marketed alongside the "Saja Boys" meal.
The "Saja Boys" meal is a breakfast alternative.
The "Saja Boys" meal features a honey sriracha McMuffin.
